dot-t2.label: PBKS dot-ball rate batting, 2024–2026
dot-t2.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
dot-t2.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (7,12) AND d.total_runs = 0 AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (7,12) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.total_runs = 0 AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) league, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (7,12) AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY year HAVING balls > 0 ORDER BY year

dot-wlow.label: IPL win rate for innings with under 30% dot balls
dot-wlow.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
dot-wlow.query: WITH inn AS (SELECT i.innings_id, i.batting_team_id bt, i.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.total_runs = 0 AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dots FROM innings i JOIN deliveries d ON d.innings_id = i.innings_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY i.innings_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 60) SELECT CASE WHEN dots < 0.30 THEN 'under 30%' WHEN dots < 0.36 THEN '30–36%' WHEN dots < 0.42 THEN '36–42%' ELSE '42% or more' END band, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id = inn.bt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM inn JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = inn.match_id WHERE m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY band
